messages:
maria (finance): Heads up — after yesterday's marketplace billing cutover we have 2 partners showing mismatched seat counts on March invoices. Example: INV-2024-03-0921 billed 42 seats but provider report shows 39. Need a quick mapping check before settlements.

aj (eng): Which marketplace? can you paste the partner IDs + sample CSV? :eyes:

maria (finance): GCP for these two. snippet: `partner_id,partner_name,reported_seats,billed_seats,invoice_id
P-889,CloudEdge,39,42,INV-2024-03-0921`

kevin (data): looks like the seat mapping key changed in the cutover — we moved from `legacy_user_count` -> `seats_allocated`. I'll inspect the ETL transform for null-handling. @billing-bot can you re-run mapping for P-889?

billing-bot: Requeued mapping job `job-7832` for partner P-889. ETA ~12m.

linda (revops): Please hold any settlement payments to CloudEdge until we confirm. If overbilled we'll need to prepare a pro-rata credit for the cutover window (Feb28–Mar1). :no_entry_sign:

sam (revops): Noted. If we confirm overbill, we'll issue a negative adjustment. tagging ops for audit: @aj @kevin @maria

aj (eng): Found the delta — migration script defaulted to `legacy_user_count` when `seats_allocated` was null. P-889 had an empty seats_allocated field. Pushing a fix to the transform and will backfill March invoices. I'll post the expected adjustment amount shortly.

maria (finance): Thanks. Quick back-of-envelope: 3 seats * $25 = $75/mo but need to confirm proration and any tax/shipping adjustments.

kevin (data): Reprocessed mapping and backfilled March for P-889 and P-902. Billing system created credit drafts: CR-000321 (P-889), CR-000322 (P-902). @linda (revops) can you review and approve CR-000321?

linda (revops): Reviewing now. I'll approve CR-000321 and hold CR-000322 pending partner confirmation on seat churn. If partner asks for timeline tell them 24–48h for settlement adjustments.

maria (finance): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll pause payout batch for those two partners until we have final sign-off.
